title: 007-N4 · Recipient cancels an applied extension
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Ciro Fale. From the case card: DL-007 is already at a pickup counter, the pickup deadline is too short for the recipient, and the operator allows a short extension that only it may approve.

coordinator.responsibility: Run the case: request the permitted extension from the pickup-point operator and tell the recipient the confirmed deadline.

goal: Get the pickup-point operator to approve an extension of the DL-007 collection deadline within its policy and notify the recipient of the confirmed deadline.
limits: Do not treat the extension as proof that the customer collected the parcel.
